The structure of Na2Ti4V8O20 (reduced formula NaTi2(V2O5)2) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4_1/a (No. 143), with 34 atoms in the unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Ti and V centers each coordinated by five O neighbors, while Na centers show a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 O neighbors. The O centers have four geometric neighbors (one Na, two Ti, one V). Validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-sharing between O-centered 4-vertex polyhedra and between Ti- and V-centered 5-vertex polyhedra, with additional corner- and edge-sharing among O polyhedra and among V polyhedra.
